feature: Ownership / RACI -- the real customer-facing read surface in artifacts/portal (/ownership), wired to GET /api/portal/ownership -- see docs/portal/ownership-raci-contract-pack.md §1a. No fixture module: every row, person and honest-empty state on screen comes from that one endpoint. This build is READ-ONLY by design: the five write routes (assign/reorder/accept/decline/delegations/rows, contract pack §1b) are sibling issue #3041's scope and are not exercised here.
notes: DISCOVERED, NOT REUSED: test-manifests/portal/portal-v2-ownership.json already covers GET /api/portal/ownership, but its entire uiSteps block drives the retired portal-v2 UI (/portal-v2/ownership, pv2-own-* testids, a second nested slug router) which CLAUDE.md now forbids building against and which no longer exists as a route in artifacts/portal's App.tsx. Reusing that file would mean asserting dead selectors against a live page; this is a genuinely different component tree with its own testids, so it gets its own file per the discover-before-create rule's own instruction to create a new one when nothing matches the real route/feature.

AUTH CORE HAS LANDED since risk-register.json's own note was written (that note said no #email/#password form existed yet for artifacts/portal) -- login.tsx now ships real #email/#password inputs and a login-submit testid (verified this session, login.tsx:230/248/257), so this manifest drives a real login rather than only asserting the honest sign-in-required gate.

WHY NO WRITE APITEST HERE: the five write routes are real and already wired server-side (contract pack §1b), but nothing in this build's own frontend calls them -- assign/reorder/accept/decline/delegate/add-row are #3041's scope. Exercising them here would test code this build didn't ship.

TIER GATE: the route is wrapped in requireTierFeature(PORTAL_TIER_MODULE_KEYS.ownership) (portal-ownership.ts:426) -- a 402 with code TIER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED if the signed-in tenant's plan doesn't bundle Ownership. The UI's own distinct 'Not included in your current plan' state (ownership.tsx) is not asserted here since it depends on which plan the TEST_PORTAL account currently carries; A1 below simply asserts whatever the real account's real entitlement returns.
ENV VARS (BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables): DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

apiTests.name: SETUP -- log in as the designated testbed portal account; extract the bearer.
A1 -- the route answers 200 for a CustomerUser whose plan bundles Ownership (the real, most common state for this test account); take the first real row's id/name to assert against the DOM.
A2 -- ...and its real name, the value OWN3 below proves reached the DOM.

A3 -- the eight-source honesty list is always exactly present, and the control register is always stated as not-built rather than omitted (contract pack §6) -- found by type, not by index, since #2008 has already reordered this array once.
A4 -- the write overlay is always served as arrays, even empty ones -- what this build's UI reads to render saved assignments/delegations/added rows.
A5 -- the signed-in user resolved to a real person id on their own roster.

uiSteps.name: WAIT for the login form to hydrate before typing.
Primary login -- every assertion below needs a real session.
OWN1 -- the page resolved to Ownership.
OWN2 -- a live-state line renders (loading/live/partly-served/error, never a blank header).
OWN3 -- THE REAL-DATA ASSERTION. The row the ENDPOINT returned first is on screen, under its own real name. A page falling back to fixture/placeholder text has no element with this id at all.
OWN4 -- that row's four RACI cells are all present, proving the matrix renders a full row rather than a partial one.
OWN8 -- the ledger of what this read-only build deliberately does not do is on screen, naming that write actions land with #3041 rather than silently omitting them.
